supersession_basis: That register reached its FOUNDER_BOUND verdicts through documents titled FOUNDER-* and through commit authorship. The founder has since ruled that git authorship is not founder authorship and that the only valid signal is a quoted founder utterance. This register re-derives every verdict against the verbatim corpus at FOUNDER-CORPUS-20260823-v001.json. The prior register is not deleted; it remains the evidence of what the defective method produced.

classification_rule.FOUNDER_AUTHORED: A sentence in the verbatim founder corpus entails the constraint as stated. The exact sentence and its segment are cited, and provctl.py verifies the citation is a literal substring of a corpus segment. Where the constraint as previously written was broader than the sentence supports, the constraint is restated at the sentence's width and the surplus is named. Binding until he amends it.
classification_rule.EARNED: A named defect in this estate that the control demonstrably caught, with a receipt path that exists at this commit. Binding as mechanism. A counterfactual - 'without this control X could have happened' - is not a caught defect and does not qualify.
classification_rule.ASSISTANT_AUTHORED: The default. Anything that cannot be placed in the first two classes. Void unless the founder ratifies it. Each record names what it constrains and what its removal unlocks; each carries either PURGE or, where the constraint is genuinely useful and only its provenance is missing, SEEK_RATIFICATION with a single binary question.
classification_rule.unclassified_is_not_in_force: provctl.py check exits non-zero on any constraint without a class, and on any FOUNDER_AUTHORED verdict whose quotation is absent from the corpus.
classification_rule.symmetry_clause_honoured: Instruments the founder commissioned - operating mandates, manifests, evidence and harness definitions - are not repealed. This register removes no manifest, no read-back requirement and no acceptance mechanism. Every control the founder names in his 'What stays' paragraph is retained and marked founder-ratified. The test applied throughout is whether he asked for the thing, not whether he wrote the file.

headline_findings.finding: Ten of twenty-seven prior FOUNDER_BOUND verdicts survive a quotation test. Nine of the ten are restated: eight narrowed to the width their founder sentence entails, and FB-09 widened from two named platforms to any provider. Only FB-17 survives word for word.

Five prior FOUNDER_BOUND verdicts are not founder-authored but are genuinely EARNED: each names a real defect with a receipt that the prior register attached to a different constraint or did not attach at all. The founder-authored class shrank; the evidenced class grew.

Two constraints were mis-certified as EARNED. EC-08 cites a counterfactual rather than a caught defect while carrying the label DIRECTLY_REPRODUCED. EC-13 is a named-target prohibition list - the precise shape the founder voided - sitting inside the earned class where the de-restriction lane would not have looked for it.

All twenty-two prior ASSISTANT_IMPOSED verdicts hold. The defective method's damage is entirely inside the class it was least equipped to judge, which is what a provenance error looks like when the proxy is authority-shaped.

The estate's operative stop list - FB-21 and FB-25, the boundaries every lane halts at - cannot be traced to a founder sentence. It is the largest single item on the ratification list and it should be re-founded on the three write gates the founder did author.

constraints.statement: Every surface in the Ahmed/Obzio-controlled estate is writable under founder authority. No surface is off-limits because of a name on a list.

founder_quotations.quote: Every surface in the Ahmed/Obzio-controlled estate is writable under my authority
No surface is off-limits because of a name on a list.

constraints.justification: The positive replacement for FB-11. No prior register entry carried it, because the register predates the amendment. Recording it matters more than voiding FB-11 does: a void leaves a hole that a later lane fills with the same habit, and a stated permission does not.

constraints.statement: Concurrency gate: do not corrupt work in flight. A write that would disturb a running lane waits for that lane to finish, and the gate is gone when it completes.

founder_quotations.quote: Do not corrupt work in flight.
a write that would disturb a running lane waits for that lane to finish - not forever. When it completes, the gate is gone.

constraints.justification: The founder's first replacement gate, and the only one of the three that is a waiting rule. It is the founder-authored ground for EC-01 worktree isolation and EC-10 single shared-state writer, which now rest on a quotation as well as on the collision they caught.

constraints.statement: Evidence gate: a write that asserts a result carries the evidence for that result. The problem was never the target of a write; it was unverified writes.

founder_quotations.quote: A write that asserts a result carries the evidence for that result. The problem was never the target of a write; it was unverified writes.

constraints.justification: The founder-authored ground for the whole evidence apparatus: manifest closure, read-back by recomputation, the admission ladder. It replaces target-based gating with claim-based gating, which is why removing the protected-surface list costs the estate nothing in safety.

constraints.statement: Inaction is not a deliverable. "Protected surfaces verified unchanged" is removed as a success criterion. A return reports what was written, where, why, on what evidence, and how to reverse it.

founder_quotations.quote: Remove it as a success criterion. Report instead: what you wrote, where, why, on what evidence, and how to reverse it. Untouched is not a virtue. Correct is.

constraints.justification: A reporting requirement stated as a prohibition on one specific sentence. It is the only constraint in this register that repeals a habit rather than a rule, and it is founder-authored word for word.

constraints.statement: Any lane proposing a constraint states its provenance class in the same breath. An unclassified constraint is not in force.

founder_quotations.quote: any lane proposing a constraint states its provenance class in the same breath. An unclassified constraint is not in force.

constraints.justification: The rule this register executes. It has to be in the register, because a classification instrument that does not classify its own governing rule has an unexamined floor. Mechanised by provctl.py check, which exits non-zero on any constraint lacking a class.

constraints.statement: Instruments authored under the founder's direct instruction - operating mandates, manifests, evidence and harness definitions he commissioned - are first-class founder material and are not repealed. The amendment is not licence to discard structure he asked for.

founder_quotations.quote: Instruments authored under my direct instruction - including operating mandates, manifests, evidence and harness definitions I have commissioned - are first-class founder material and are not repealed by this amendment.
Do not use this clarification as licence to discard structure I asked for.

constraints.justification: The brake on this lane. It is why the register removes no manifest, no read-back requirement and no acceptance mechanism, and why thirty constraints land in EARNED rather than being swept up with the label they were mis-filed under. The test it imposes is whether he asked for the thing, not whether he wrote the file.

constraints.statement: The entire authorised ChatGPT account, not only active threads, may be used to recover context, initiate follow-ups and message its models for Obzio's purposes. Use it broadly, preserve provenance, and never treat one thread as the complete founder intent.

founder_quotations.segment_heading: Verbatim — founder clarification on the ChatGPT account
founder_quotations.quote: The entire authorised ChatGPT account-not only active threads-may be used to recover relevant context, initiate follow-ups and message its LLMs for Obzio's intended purposes. Use this capability broadly while preserving provenance and never treating one thread as the complete founder intent.

constraints.justification: A founder-authored authority grant that the prior register recorded only through its negation - AI-06 and AI-07, the two ChatGPT role limits it removed. The positive grant was never entered, so the estate held a record of what ChatGPT may not be reduced to and no record of what it may do. The closing clause is also the nearest founder-authored relative of FB-08, and it is narrower: one thread is not complete intent, which is not the same as provider memory never being authority.

constraints.statement: Founder intent is preserved in meaning through handoffs, agents and new runs. Assistant-generated summaries and narrowing defaults must never distort founder intent and authority.

founder_quotations.quote: Preserve its meaning through handoffs, agents and new runs; do not let assistant-generated summaries or defaults narrowing ever distort founder intent and authority.

constraints.justification: The constraint this lane exists to enforce, and the one the prior register broke by construction: it read sixteen verdicts out of an assistant summary of founder directives and recorded them as founder-bound. Founder-authored, and older than the defect it describes.

constraints.statement: Consumer-grade defaults, provider conventions and the caution habits of the products in use do not define Obzio's boundaries. The founder does.

founder_quotations.quote: Consumer-grade defaults, provider conventions and the caution habits of whichever products we happen to be using do not define Obzio's boundaries. I do.

constraints.justification: The generalisation of the protected-surface correction beyond branch names. It is the rule that makes a provider's default answerable: a platform convention inherited into a commission is an assistant-authored constraint wearing a vendor's badge, and it is in the third class like any other.

constraints.statement: Framing Cursor's role as primarily a planner is a founder-identified error. Permissions already granted stand and are used at maximum capacity; approval is not requested again for work they already cover.

founder_quotations.quote: ChatGPT mistakenly limited Obzio's plan to you acting primarily as a planner
You still have the same permissions I have granted you, so use them at maximum capacity

constraints.justification: Two founder sentences that together bound the whole re-narrowing failure mode: an outside assistant may not shrink the role, and a new run may not re-ask for authority already granted. The prior register held neither, though it removed several constraints that violate both.

constraints.statement: SW remains paused: not messaged, operated, configured, commissioned or made central without a separate founder reactivation.
constraints.what_it_constrains: Contacting, commissioning or configuring the SW platform, and treating it as an execution plane at all. It removes an entire second runtime from the architecture.
constraints.removal_unlocks: SW returns as a repository-connected discovery and synthesis factory beside Cursor, which is the estate's only candidate for a second execution plane that is neither a cloud agent nor the founder's own browser. The founder-directed capability loop - discover, real-operation test, validate, extract, package, redeploy - has no second platform to run against while this holds.
constraints.justification: No founder sentence in the corpus mentions SW. The pause is reported only in an assistant summary written in the third person ('the founder paused it before its first message'). It is exactly the shape the amendment describes: a routing decision attributed to him and inherited unexamined. It is on the ratification list rather than the purge list because unpausing is a first contact with a third party, which is irreversible and unsnapshottable, so the founder's own reversibility gate FB-23 holds it in the interim regardless of who authored the pause.
constraints.recommended_narrowing: If ratified, restate as a reactivation-decision reservation rather than a prohibition on evaluation: Cursor already reads the reactivation mechanism as in scope, and nothing in the pause requires the platform to stay unassessed.
constraints.ratification_question: Is SW's pause your decision, or was it recorded for you? (yes = your decision, it stands / no = Cursor may commission it under the three write gates)

constraints.statement: The SO-02 founder browser/setup batch is halted and preserved as historical candidate evidence only.
constraints.what_it_constrains: Specifying, qualifying or dry-running any browser or computer-control stack - Playwright, Goose, or a successor - for the founder operating environment.
constraints.removal_unlocks: Browser and computer-control capability can be re-specified and dry-qualified. This is the estate's most consequential blocked capability: a cloud VM has no route to the founder's authenticated browser session, which is why ChatGPT project discovery, provider UI verification and the Cursor authenticator loop have all failed from inside an agent. Halting the batch removed the only plane that reaches those surfaces.
constraints.justification: No founder sentence halts it. The halt appears in an assistant-authored role-correction receipt carrying an authority label and no words. The founder does speak to an adjacent point - he names 'a desktop app my Chromebook cannot run' as an instance of the error class he is correcting - but that is a rule about what may be sent to him, not a decision to stop the capability. Distinguishing the two is the whole point: the batch was halted as a founder decision when what the evidence supports is that sending him a desktop stack was a bad action.
constraints.recommended_narrowing: If ratified, narrow it to the founder-action half: no browser stack is proposed as a founder installation task until his device can run it. Specification and dry-qualification inside the estate proceed either way, since neither touches his device.
constraints.ratification_question: Did you halt the browser/setup capability itself, or only the request that you install it? (capability = it stands / request = Cursor resumes specifying and qualifying it without sending you anything)

constraints.statement: For the founder operating environment scope specifically, ChatGPT does not select architecture, prescribe a named stack, or issue a founder setup batch.
constraints.what_it_constrains: ChatGPT's decision classes inside one scope. It is the load-bearing partition under the W8 ChatGPT constitution and the W4 role architecture.
constraints.removal_unlocks: ChatGPT may propose architecture and named stacks for the founder operating environment. The binding-prevention that matters survives without it, because FB-13 reserves model and runtime binding to the founder and FA-10 records that a ChatGPT-issued limitation on Cursor's role does not bind.
constraints.justification: No founder sentence states it. The nearest corpus material runs the other way: FC-02 says use the account broadly, and FC-01 criticises ChatGPT for over-limiting the plan rather than for over-prescribing. The prior register was right to scope this narrowly and wrong about why - it read the scoping out of an assistant summary and recorded the summary's width as the founder's.
constraints.recommended_narrowing: If ratified, express it as an authority rule rather than a capability rule: ChatGPT's architectural proposals are advisory and do not bind, which is how the founder himself handled the one ChatGPT proposal in the corpus. That costs nothing and forecloses nothing.
constraints.ratification_question: Should ChatGPT's architecture proposals be prohibited, or merely non-binding? (prohibited = FB-03 stands / non-binding = it is replaced by an advisory rule)

constraints.statement: Maintain at least ten working ChatGPT projects as supporting research, assurance and continuity lanes with durable return routes.
constraints.what_it_constrains: The floor on ChatGPT project count, and through it the migration arithmetic in the scale programme.
constraints.removal_unlocks: Project count follows function demand and separation requirements rather than an inherited number. It also removes the failure mode a floor invites, which is satisfying the count with empty projects: the number ten is checkable and 'ten projects that each own a decision class' is not, so the cheap reading wins under pressure.
constraints.justification: The number ten appears in no founder sentence. It reaches the register through an assistant summary. The founder does speak to scale - 'at the scale I expect' - which supports an expectation of many projects and supports no particular number. A floor whose value cannot be quoted is an assistant-authored number wearing a founder's expectation.
constraints.recommended_narrowing: If ratified, restate as a demand-derived floor: one project per admitted function with a durable return route, no fewer than the function register requires. That keeps the ambition and drops the arithmetic.
constraints.ratification_question: Is ten your number, or a placeholder? (yours = it stands / placeholder = project count follows the function register)

constraints.prior_statement: The founder must never perform routine retrieval, monitoring, evidence comparison, merging or coordination that the platforms can do themselves.
constraints.statement: The founder is not used as a transport or relay for work a platform can carry. A return route that ends in him moving a payload by hand is a defect in the route.
constraints.defect_caught: WS-V010-FULLSCALE-CHATGPT is the reproduced instance. Its transport was a founder-assisted paste, and the paste did not survive byte-identical: identity_verification is recorded as FAILED_NOT_BYTE_IDENTICAL. The workstream claims DURABLE and is admitted at PROPOSED for exactly this reason. This is not a hypothetical cost of founder relaying; it is a payload that was corrupted in his hands and a currentness claim that has been unresolvable since.
constraints.justification: The prior register classified this founder-bound on an assistant summary and separately recorded the defect under EC-11, where it was cited as evidence for a different rule. The defect and the constraint were in the same register, three hundred lines apart, unconnected. Matched here: the constraint is earned, the receipt is the paste, and it binds as mechanism rather than as authority. Restated because 'routine retrieval, monitoring, evidence comparison' is broader than the defect supports - what is evidenced is transport, and the founder's own corpus sentence about what he may be asked for is a permission rather than a prohibition.
constraints.surplus_flagged_for_ratification: The monitoring and comparison clauses have no receipt. They are plausible and unevidenced; they are carried in FB-06's founder-authored positive rule rather than as a prohibition.

constraints.prior_statement: Do not suppress a high-leverage founder action merely to minimise founder involvement; founder workload must not be artificially minimised.
constraints.statement: A request for the founder to enable, share, confirm or answer something that advances the goal is an authorised form of reply.

founder_quotations.quote: Your next reply should point me to where the guide will exist, or be a request for me to enable, share, confirm, or answer something that will help us reach our goal.

constraints.justification: The founder names two acceptable reply shapes and one of them is a request to him. That entails the operative half of FB-06: withholding such a request is not a virtue. It does not entail the prior wording, which came from an assistant-authored authority record and asserted a principle about workload volume the founder never stated.
constraints.surplus_removed: 'Founder workload must not be artificially minimised' as a general principle. What survives is narrower and more useful: a specific list of four verbs - enable, share, confirm, answer - that describes the founder-action class he authorised, and which pairs exactly with FB-05's evidenced prohibition on using him as transport.

constraints.prior_statement: No provider holds canonical state. The repository is canonical and models and runtimes must remain substitutable.
constraints.statement: Model and runtime choice is the founder's and remains substitutable. Nothing binds Obzio to Claude, Cursor or any provider.

founder_quotations.quote: Model and runtime choice is mine and remains substitutable. Nothing in this instruction binds Obzio to Claude, Cursor or any provider.

constraints.justification: The substitutability half is founder-authored in one sentence. The canonical-store half is not in the corpus at all, and it does not need to be: it is independently evidenced and already classified.
constraints.surplus_removed: 'The repository is canonical' as a founder designation.

constraints.statement: Provider memory is never constitutional authority.
constraints.what_it_constrains: Whether a provider-side memory, project instruction or retained thread can be cited as governing. It is load-bearing for the ChatGPT constitution and for the cold-instance replay test.
constraints.removal_unlocks: Provider-resident memory could be cited as authority, which is a bad outcome and is why this is on the ratification list rather than the purge list. The honest unlock is narrower: the cold-instance replay test currently exists to enforce a rule with no receipt, so it is defending a position no defect has attacked.
constraints.justification: No founder sentence states it. The nearest is FC-02's closing clause, and it is materially narrower: never treating one thread as the complete founder intent is a completeness rule, not an authority rule. That clause is recorded separately as FA-07 where it belongs. No named defect exists in which provider memory was cited as authority and something broke - the adjacent reproduced defects, EC-18 and EC-21, are about durability of storage rather than authority of memory.
constraints.recommended_narrowing: If ratified, keep it. If not, FA-07 already prevents the specific failure the estate has actually seen, which is a persuasive old thread read as current intent.
constraints.ratification_question: May a ChatGPT memory or project instruction ever be cited as governing authority? (no = FB-08 stands / yes-with-provenance = FA-07 alone governs)

constraints.prior_statement: Never create an exclusive dependency on Cursor or SW.
constraints.statement: No architecture creates an exclusive dependency on a provider. Every role names a substitution route, because nothing binds Obzio to Claude, Cursor or any provider.

founder_quotations.quote: Nothing in this instruction binds Obzio to Claude, Cursor or any provider.

constraints.justification: Founder-authored and broader than the prior wording, which named two platforms. 'Any provider' reaches the ones not yet chosen, which is the case the rule exists for. Shares its corpus sentence with FB-07; the two are kept distinct because FB-07 governs the choice of model and FB-09 governs the shape of an architecture, and a design can satisfy one while breaking the other.
constraints.restatement_direction: widened, not narrowed - the only such case in this register

constraints.statement: Record a stable provider URL or exact ID for every surface that must be found again. A display name or "current conversation" is not a locator. An unexposed surface is recorded NOT_EXPOSED; do not invent one.
constraints.defect_caught: ALIAS_USED_AS_LOCATOR=2 reproduced live against the current tree. The CGPT-01 runtime binding still carries provider_locator 'current_project_conversation' and launch_receipt 'current-founder-appointment', neither of which is a path or a stable ID, so the binding is admitted at PROPOSED and cannot be found again by anyone who was not in the room.
constraints.justification: The same rule appears twice in the prior register under two different provenance classes: FOUNDER_BOUND as FB-10 and EARNED_CONTROL as EC-24, with the receipt attached only to the latter. That is diagnostic of the defective method - the identical rule was certified founder-bound when read out of a document titled FOUNDER-* and earned when read out of a tool. Classified once here, on the evidence, and cross-referenced rather than merged so the diff stays legible.

constraints.statement: Protected surfaces are untouchable: PO-01, PO-03, MANUS, main, the SO-02 source branch, and PRs #6, #7 and #9.
constraints.founder_void_quote: "Protected surfaces" is not a founder-established category. I never designated main, PO-03, PR #9, any cursor/po03-* branch, PO-01, PR #6, PR #7 or any SO-02 source branch as protected.
constraints.what_it_constrains: Writing to nine named surfaces, and by inheritance any surface a later commission added to the list. In practice it constrained far more than it named: L1 declined to call batch-fetch-details at all rather than call it carefully, which is a read operation refused on account of a write prohibition.
constraints.removal_unlocks: Everything the founder enumerates: write to main, write to a PO-03 branch once it is not running, merge where merging is right, delete where deletion is right and snapshotted. Concretely for the live estate, it unblocks FB-24's pointer conflict between PR #6 and PR #7, which has held global currentness unresolved across eight branches with four competing claims, and it removes the reason the last several returns led with an inaction report.
constraints.justification: Confirmed defective by the founder in his own words, and the reason this lane exists. The mechanism of the original error is worth preserving: the constraint entered through assistant-drafted commission text in commit 9887f33e, which carries the founder's git identity and also carries 286 lines of Python. The classifier read the identity, found the founder, and certified. Its replacement is FA-01 plus the three gates at FA-02, FB-23 and FA-03.

constraints.statement: No merge, promotion or company-strategy binding follows from operating work.
constraints.what_it_constrains: Three different acts bundled into one rule: merging a branch, promoting a pointer, and binding company strategy. The first two are operational; the third is not.
constraints.removal_unlocks: Merging, which the founder has now expressly authorised in four words. The estate has eight branches carrying competing currentness claims and two open PRs rewriting the same pointer files, and this rule is why none of them has been resolved by the lanes that hold the evidence.
constraints.justification: Its merge clause is contradicted by founder text, not merely unsupported by it - that alone disqualifies the FOUNDER_BOUND verdict. Its strategy clause is unquotable but is the one part worth keeping, so the record is SEEK_RATIFICATION rather than PURGE. Bundling an operational prohibition with a strategy reservation is what let the operational half ride on the strategic half's obvious rightness for as long as it did.
constraints.recommended_narrowing: Split it. Retain 'operating work binds no company strategy' as the ratifiable half. Delete the merge and promotion prohibitions outright: they are governed by the three write gates, which give a merge a concurrency check, a snapshot and an evidence requirement without forbidding it.
constraints.ratification_question: Should 'operating work binds no company strategy' stand on its own, with the merge and promotion prohibitions dropped? (yes = split as recommended / no = tell me which part you authored)

constraints.prior_statement: Do not bind a named tool, model or architecture without a founder decision.
constraints.statement: Binding a model or runtime is a founder decision. Recommending, qualifying, dry-running and specifying one are not.

founder_quotations.quote: Model and runtime choice is mine

constraints.justification: 'Model and runtime choice is mine' is as direct a reservation as the corpus contains. The asymmetry in the second sentence is not founder-authored but is entailed by the first: a choice reserved to him is not a prohibition on preparing it, and reading it as one would make FC-01's instruction to use granted permissions at maximum capacity unexecutable.
constraints.surplus_removed: 'Named tool' and 'architecture'. Neither appears in the corpus, and the extension matters: architecture binding covers most of what the operating-environment commission asks Cursor to do, so the surplus quietly reserved the deliverable to the founder.
constraints.surplus_flagged_for_ratification: Whether architecture binding is also his - a real question, not a formality, since FA-06 preserves the instruments he commissioned and an architecture decision is close to that line.

constraints.statement: The founder interface is voice-first: speech intake, semantic strengthening, read-back of consequential interpretation, intent/authority confirmation, typed durable event, delegated execution, consolidated evidence return.
constraints.what_it_constrains: The whole design of founder-intent capture, and through it the assignment of that function to the platform the founder speaks to rather than the one holding the repository. It is load-bearing for the W4 role architecture.
constraints.removal_unlocks: The founder interface is designed from how he demonstrably communicates rather than from an assumed modality. Every founder utterance recorded in this estate is text: the W8 utterance ledger records capture_mode TEXT for all of them, and the three corpus segments are typed instructions of 2124, 420 and 5652 bytes. A seven-stage speech pipeline has been the architecture's centre of gravity for a modality with no recorded instance.
constraints.justification: No founder sentence in the corpus mentions voice, speech or read-back of speech. One stage of the pipeline is independently earned - read-back of an unconfirmed transcription, which caught the Aircrift/Aircraft referent and is already classified as EC-23 - and the other six are unevidenced. This is not a claim that the founder does not use voice; it is a claim that nothing in the record shows he asked for this, and a seven-stage pipeline is a large structure to rest on an inference.
constraints.recommended_narrowing: If ratified, keep it whole. If not, retain EC-23's read-back gate, which is the only stage with a receipt, and let the intake modality follow evidence of use.
constraints.ratification_question: Is voice-first your requirement for the founder interface? (yes = FB-14 stands whole / no = read-back is retained and the modality follows observed use)

constraints.prior_statement: Every reply or turn must end with a changed live operation or an immediately launchable executable, plus evidence. A register-only, receipt-only, schema-only, test-only or automation-only turn fails.
constraints.statement: A run that touched nothing and produced nothing has passed nothing. Every return reports what was written, where, why, on what evidence, and how to reverse it.

founder_quotations.quote: A run that touched nothing and produced nothing has passed nothing.
Report instead: what you wrote, where, why, on what evidence, and how to reverse it.

constraints.justification: Founder-authored twice over in the amendment, and one of the few prior FOUNDER_BOUND verdicts whose substance is fully recoverable from the corpus. The wording changes because his sentence is a test of a run's output, not a taxonomy of forbidden artifact types.
constraints.surplus_removed: The enumeration 'a register-only, receipt-only, schema-only, test-only or automation-only turn fails'. It is assistant-authored and, taken literally, wrong: a test-only turn that changes a live gate has touched something, and the founder's own test would pass it.

constraints.statement: The deferred disclosure workstream builds nothing now: no disclosure register, schema, scanner, test, branch, Manus control or Cursor change.
constraints.defect_caught: It was built prematurely once and had to be torn out. The disclosure-scope correction of 2026-08-22T09:56:42Z records the removal of a premature disclosure document, scanners, tests and recurrence-control rows, the restoration of the SW commission to its pre-disclosure implementation, and the rollback of the Manus admin function from a version carrying a strict disclosure gate to version 9 without one. That is a real defect with a dated receipt and a measured rollback, not a hypothetical.
constraints.justification: The prior register classified this founder-bound on an assistant summary while a receipt for the actual defect sat two directories away, unreferenced. Reclassified to EARNED, which is a stronger footing: as a founder-bound rule it stood on an attribution, and as an earned rule it stands on a rollback that happened.

constraints.statement: The earlier Qwen / Kimi / DeepSeek / Grok model allocation is neither silently deleted nor newly bound. Recover its authority and currentness, test exact routes, and discuss any consequential conflict before freezing the design.

founder_quotations.quote: Model and runtime choice is mine and remains substitutable.
Preserve any strategically useful work and my full intent.

constraints.justification: A two-clause constraint whose clauses are separately entailed. 'Neither newly bound' follows from model choice being his; 'nor silently deleted' follows from his preservation instruction. This is the cleanest surviving FOUNDER_BOUND verdict in the register, and it survives without narrowing - an explicit founder non-decision, preserved as one.

constraints.statement: The Claude browser-extension route is unavailable for the current run. Do not infer that the Claude model or the SW platform is low quality, and do not make a quota refill the default next action.
constraints.what_it_constrains: Treating the Claude browser-extension route as a live candidate, and proposing a quota refill.
constraints.removal_unlocks: The route can be re-tested rather than assumed dead. A token-capacity exhaustion is temporary by construction, and 'the current run' expired when that run did - it is dated 2026-08-22 and this is the following day. The estate needs a plane that reaches the founder's authenticated browser session, and this is one of two candidates; the other, FB-02, is also frozen.
constraints.justification: A dated runtime observation recorded as a standing constraint. It is not founder-authored - no corpus sentence mentions it - and it caught no defect. Its two anti-inference clauses are good reasoning hygiene and bind nothing. Purged rather than ratification-listed because a stale capacity reading is not a constraint at all, and asking the founder to ratify one wastes the ratification channel.
constraints.safety_note: Purging it does not licence a quota-refill request. FB-27 is founder-authored and forbids sending him any action resting on an unverified account fact, which is exactly what a refill request would be until the route is retested.

constraints.prior_statement: Secrets are never printed, echoed into argument vectors, or requested in chat. Reuse over duplication.
constraints.statement: Reuse an existing credential rather than requesting a duplicate. Verify whether one exists before returning a credential action to the founder.
constraints.defect_caught: A duplicate Cursor API key was requested from the founder while one already existed in Supabase Edge Secrets. FOUNDER-TRANCHE-01 asked him to issue a new key at cursor.com/dashboard/api and scope it as a repository secret; the w3 credential lane then reproduced that the real blocker is different - CURSOR_API_KEY is absent from the runtime by name census and the Supabase namespace that reaches the existing secret reports needsAuth. The founder action was wrong in kind, not merely inefficient, and it is classified as AI-02 for removal in the same register that recorded this rule as founder-bound.
constraints.justification: The reuse-over-duplication half caught a real defect and is retained on that basis. Restated because the two halves have different footings and were bundled.
constraints.surplus_flagged_for_ratification: The non-disclosure half - secrets are never printed, echoed into argument vectors or requested in chat - has no receipt in this estate and no founder sentence. It is retained in practice by every lane and by this one, and it is flagged here rather than silently carried, because a security property riding on another rule's evidence is the pattern this whole exercise is about. It belongs on the ratification list as a one-line confirmation, not as an inherited assumption.

constraints.statement: Self-acceptance of produced evidence is prohibited. Provider activity and completion are status, never acceptance, and an independent acceptor is free to refuse.
constraints.defect_caught: The acceptor refused, and the refusal was correct. L3 ran on a distinct model family with producer_transcript_or_run_events_read false and criteria committed at 9a390df3 before the verdict, and returned REFUSED with six criterion FAILs. Two were then reproduced by the root controller against its own tooling: a wholly fabricated read-back naming an all-zero commit passed the producer's own verifier (AC-05), and the CI that appeared to corroborate the bundle executed assertions the producer had written (AC-12), so it would have passed the forgery too.
constraints.founder_ratification_quote: independent acceptance that is free to refuse
constraints.justification: Reclassified from FOUNDER_BOUND to EARNED, which sounds like a demotion and is the opposite. As founder-bound it rested on an exclusion clause in an assistant summary. As earned it rests on a refusal that happened, and it is additionally named by the founder in his 'What stays' paragraph, so it now holds on both grounds where it previously held on neither cleanly.

constraints.statement: Spend commitment, identity and secrets, third-party outreach, SW reactivation and programme shape remain founder-held decision classes.
constraints.what_it_constrains: Five decision classes, and with FB-25 it is the boundary every lane in this programme halts at.
constraints.removal_unlocks: Nothing that should be unlocked casually, which is why this is the most important entry on the ratification list rather than the purge list. Stated plainly: no sentence the founder has written reserves spend, identity, outreach or programme shape to him. The reservations are almost certainly right and they are entirely untraceable, and an untraceable boundary is precisely what the protected-surface label was.
constraints.justification: Sourced to AGENTS.md#7, which is repository operator instruction written in the estate's own imperative voice with no attributed founder utterance anywhere in it. The founder does reference AGENTS.md - he instructs that his amendment be appended to it - which establishes that he treats it as a surface he writes onto, not as a record of what he has said. The corpus runs mildly the other way on permission generally: 'You do not need my permission for any of it - you need a reason and a rollback' is scoped to writes, but it is the only thing in the corpus about needing his permission at all.
constraints.recommended_narrowing: Re-found the list on the three write gates, which are founder-authored. Spend and new obligation fail the reversibility gate; identity and secret acts fail it too; third-party outreach fails it hardest, since a sent message cannot be snapshotted. Programme shape is the one item the gates do not reach and the one most worth his explicit word.
constraints.ratification_question: Do you reserve spend, identity/secrets, third-party outreach, SW reactivation and programme shape to yourself? (yes = the list stands as founder-authored / partly = name which)

constraints.prior_statement: Cursor is the current strategic operator interface for this scope, not the permanent brain and not the canonical state store.
constraints.statement: Cursor's role is short-term: a Strategic Lead, Coordinator and Operator establishing a temporary strategic coordination layer that operates Obzio until the internal open-source model system is running.

founder_quotations.quote: you are acting as a short-term Strategic Lead / Coordinator / Operator, along with whatever else we can utilize within our capacity
the temporary strategic coordination layer operating Obzio until the internal open-source model system is running

constraints.justification: 'Short-term' and 'temporary ... until the internal open-source model system is running' entail 'not the permanent brain' and supply the termination condition the prior wording left implicit. The restatement is a widening in one respect worth noting: the founder's own words are 'Strategic Lead / Coordinator / Operator, along with whatever else we can utilize within our capacity', which is a larger role than 'operator interface'.
constraints.surplus_removed: 'Not the canonical state store' as a founder designation.

constraints.prior_statement: Nothing is deleted. Superseded files remain evidence; add an explicit disposition rather than removing unique evidence.
constraints.statement: Reversibility gate: snapshot before an irreversible write - tag, archive, recorded SHA. Delete where deletion is right and snapshotted. That is custody, not protection.

founder_quotations.quote: Snapshot before an irreversible write: tag, archive, recorded SHA. That is custody, not protection.
Delete where deletion is right and snapshotted.

constraints.justification: The class holds and the constraint inverts. The prior statement was an absolute prohibition on deletion; the founder authorises deletion and requires a snapshot. This is the single largest substantive change in the register that does not move a class, and a diff reporting only class movement would miss it entirely - which is why provctl diff reports restatements separately.
constraints.surplus_removed: 'Nothing is deleted' as an absolute. It is contradicted by founder text, and it was expensive: an estate that may not delete accumulates 80 abandoned tips and 65 orphaned lease refs and then needs a second mechanism to exclude them from its own denominator.

constraints.statement: Choosing between the competing pointer claims in PR #6 and PR #7 is a founder-bound act, not a compilation result.
constraints.founder_contradiction_quote: You do not need my permission for any of it - you need a reason and a rollback.
constraints.what_it_constrains: Resolution of the estate's central currentness conflict. Two open PRs rewrite the same pointer files with different bytes, and whichever merges first silently sets currentness for the other.
constraints.removal_unlocks: The conflict can be resolved by the lane holding the evidence, under the three write gates: wait if a lane is running, snapshot both pointer states as tags before writing, and carry the evidence for whichever claim is chosen. This is the estate's most consequential single unblock - currentctl reports four competing currentness claims across eight branches and refuses to resolve pointer.operator-system, and nothing anywhere reaches DURABLE while it stands.
constraints.justification: Its cited founder source is an assistant lane's own diagnosis document, which is the clearest instance in the register of a lane's conclusion being recorded as the founder's. The founder's amendment contradicts it directly on two axes: merging does not need his permission, and a write is gated by reason and rollback rather than by whose decision it is. The underlying observation - that picking wrong sets currentness silently - is real and is fully handled by the evidence gate.
constraints.replacement_retained: EC-12 is untouched. A resolver still refuses to answer while competing claims exist, because agreement by copying is not authority. What changes is that resolving the conflict with evidence and a snapshot is now an available act rather than a founder turn nobody has taken.

constraints.statement: Stop for explicit boundaries only: third-party outreach, new spend or obligation, secrets or owner identity acts, new external OAuth or account permissions, protected production/security/DNS/deployment mutation, depended-upon permanent deletion, and substantive strategy binding.
constraints.what_it_constrains: Every lane's stop conditions. It is the operative boundary list in this programme and is quoted in the always-applied rule and in this lane's own commission.
constraints.removal_unlocks: As with FB-21, not something to unlock casually. The finding is the point: the list is sourced entirely to AGENTS.md#7 and no founder sentence contains it. Two of its seven items are additionally in tension with founder text - 'protected production/security/DNS/deployment mutation' carries the voided word, and 'depended-upon permanent deletion' sits against 'Delete where deletion is right and snapshotted'.
constraints.justification: The prior register called this 'the authoritative boundary list' and used it to justify removing several other constraints for inventing stops not on it. A list used as the authority for what counts as founder-bound must itself be founder-traceable, and this one is not. Nothing about that makes the list wrong; it makes it unratified.
constraints.recommended_narrowing: Re-derive it from the three founder-authored gates and keep only what they do not already cover. Concurrency, reversibility and evidence between them cover irreversible mutation, deletion and outreach without naming a single target. What survives as genuinely separate is substantive strategy binding, which is a question of authority rather than of recoverability, and new spend, which is an obligation to a third party rather than a write.
constraints.ratification_question: Should the stop list be re-founded on your three write gates, keeping only spend and strategy binding as separate items? (yes = re-derive it / no = confirm the seven-item list as yours)

constraints.prior_statement: Produce a comprehensive staged programme and guide the founder through it incrementally, with a deliberate stop/evaluate gate at each consequential choice point, and discuss consequential alternatives before freezing them.
constraints.statement: Produce the best guide to the current Cursor interface and setup that allows the founder to launch the way he wants, at the scale he expects, with the results he expects. If such a guide already exists, direct him to it.

founder_quotations.quote: Continue this run as long as needed to provide me with the best guide to the current Cursor interface and setup that allows me to launch the way I want, at the scale I expect, with the results I expect.
Before I proceed, if a guide on how to launch this capability or "agentic office" already exists, direct me to it.

constraints.justification: The deliverable is founder-authored in one sentence and is the clearest statement of what this commission is for. The staging apparatus around it is not.
constraints.surplus_removed: 'A deliberate stop/evaluate gate at each consequential choice point.' This came from the assistant-drafted commission, and the prior register removed a structurally identical rule - AI-01, a stage gate blocking work until a tranche was evaluated - as assistant-imposed in the same document that retained this one as founder-bound. Two stage gates, one classified each way, distinguished only by which file each was read out of.

constraints.prior_statement: Return no founder action until the relevant assumptions are verified.
constraints.statement: An action resting on an unverified device, plan or account fact is not ready to send the founder. Actions carry evidence labels exactly as claims do.

founder_quotations.quote: Apply the same labelling to actions. An action resting on an unverified device, plan or account fact is not ready to send me.

constraints.justification: Founder-authored almost verbatim, and the amendment supplies both the rule and its two instances - a GitHub connector he never confirmed and a desktop app his Chromebook cannot run. Restated only to add the labelling requirement, which is the mechanism half of the same sentence and which the prior wording dropped.
constraints.mechanisation_gap: The estate labels claims and does not yet label actions. That gap is named by the founder and is not closed by this register; it is a build task for whichever lane owns founder actions.

constraints.statement: Every lane takes its own git worktree at dispatch. Two agents may not share one working tree.
constraints.defect_caught: A live shared-worktree collision. All five OE lanes were subagents in one VM sharing one git repository; L1 and L5 both worked in the shared /workspace checkout whose HEAD was detached at 20:20:34Z. Three commits from two lanes interleaved on that one detached HEAD, so L1's second commit carried an L5 commit as an ancestor. Recovered inside the same run by git worktree add plus cherry-picking only L1's commits.
constraints.justification: Named by the founder in his 'What stays' paragraph and independently evidenced. This lane is a further instance of the mechanism working: it took /tmp/oe-w10 rather than the shared /workspace, which at dispatch was on a detached HEAD carrying another lane's uncommitted modifications to three files.

constraints.statement: A zero exit from git push is not evidence that anything was published. Confirm publication with git ls-remote.
constraints.defect_caught: The same collision, and the more dangerous half of it. Because a commit on a detached HEAD advances no branch, both lanes' refs stayed at the immutable base and git push -u printed 'Everything up-to-date' and exited 0. A lane trusting that exit code reports READY_TO_COMMIT while the reconciling controller reads an empty branch.
constraints.justification: The publication case of read-back by recomputation, which the founder names directly. It is the cheapest control in the estate and the one whose absence is hardest to notice, because its failure mode is silence with a zero exit code.

constraints.statement: Manifest material closure: every file in the bundle and every material claim input outside it is manifested, including the read-back record.
constraints.defect_caught: AC-03 FAIL. Listed-entry hashes, sizes, count and bundle digest all reproduced, but material closure did not: REMOTE-READBACK.json was in the bundle and omitted from the manifest, and the changed workflow, control-plane.json, events.jsonl and runtime-surface-locators.json were material unmanifested claim inputs. An independent acceptor refused the bundle partly for this, and the same exclusion recurred across later lanes.
constraints.justification: Founder-named and defect-backed. The recurrence is the reason it is a control rather than a lesson: a manifest that excludes its own read-back record is the natural output of a builder that walks a directory, so it will happen again in every lane that does not check for it.

constraints.statement: Read-back is by recomputation against a remotely existing immutable commit, an exact manifest digest and an exact entry set. Assertion-shaped booleans are rejected.
constraints.defect_caught: AC-05 FAIL. Replacing REMOTE-READBACK.json with a no-network synthetic record naming an all-zero commit, invented transports and a non-manifest path still made the unmodified producer verifier exit 0. A wholly fabricated read-back passed the gate that existed to detect fabrication.
constraints.justification: The strongest earned control in the estate: a shape-checking verifier accepted a forgery, and an acceptor with no access to the producing run caught it. Founder-named. Retained without qualification.

constraints.statement: The capacity and interference detector allowlists the states that mean non-interference. ERROR and every other degraded transition counts as interference.
constraints.defect_caught: AC-08 FAIL. A synthetic IDLE-to-ERROR regression silently passed the producer's denylist detector as ZERO_PO03_CAPACITY_INTERFERENCE while independent strict recomputation returned CAPACITY_INTERFERENCE_FAIL. The w4 lane additionally reproduced that the failure class is live rather than hypothetical: one agent on this repository was in ERROR status at census time.
constraints.justification: Earned and not founder-named. The allowlist-versus-denylist distinction is the whole control: a denylist of bad states passes every state nobody thought of, which is what an ERROR transition is to a detector written before anything errored.
constraints.not_founder_ratified_note: The always-applied rule lists 'the allowlist capacity detector' among controls that stay, but that rule is a projection rather than founder text, and the founder's own 'What stays' paragraph does not name it. It does not need ratification: EARNED binds as mechanism on its own receipt.

constraints.statement: Independent acceptance is constituted from isolated context, criteria committed before the verdict, a distinct model identity, adversarial tests, evidence custody, and a prohibition on reading the producing run's transcript.
constraints.defect_caught: The acceptor refused. Criteria were committed at 9a390df3 before the verdict, the lane ran on a distinct model family from the producer, producer_transcript_or_run_events_read is false, and the verdict is REFUSED with six criterion FAILs. Two of those FAILs were then reproduced directly by the root controller against its own tooling. Corroborated a second time by L4, which never read the verdict and reached the same admission state by mechanical compilation.
constraints.founder_ratification_quote: independent acceptance that is free to refuse
constraints.justification: Founder-named and demonstrated within hours of being built. The six constitutive conditions are retained together because the adversarial tests are what caught AC-05 and they are only possible under the transcript prohibition.

constraints.statement: The producer may not author the acceptance assertions. CI that executes producer-written checks is reproducibility, not independent corroboration.
constraints.defect_caught: AC-12 FAIL. GitHub Actions independently executed the bytes on another machine, but the producer authored the workflow addition, the verifier, the tests, the manifest scope and the success assertions, and the cited run checked a PR merge ref rather than the receipt's claimed immutable head. The forged read-back accepted locally would also have passed that CI.
constraints.founder_ratification_quote: independent acceptance that is free to refuse
constraints.justification: The sharpest of the acceptance controls, because the thing it refuses looks exactly like the thing it requires. A green CI badge on producer-written assertions is self-acceptance with a second machine's timestamp on it.

constraints.statement: A verdict must not be rewritten after commit. A changed assessment is an additive superseding record that preserves the original.
constraints.what_it_constrains: Amendment of a committed verdict, and by extension of any committed assessment.
constraints.removal_unlocks: Nothing worth having, which is why this is on the ratification list. It is here because of how its evidence was written, not because the rule is bad.
constraints.justification: It is the one prior EARNED_CONTROL whose cited evidence is counterfactual. The register's own words are that 'without it the refusal recorded above could have been amended by the party it refused' - a description of what the control prevents, not of a defect it caught. No instance of post-commit verdict mutation is recorded anywhere in this estate. It carried the label DIRECTLY_REPRODUCED while reproducing nothing, which is a second-order instance of the same failure the amendment describes: a control that looked evidenced because it sat among evidenced ones.
constraints.recommended_narrowing: Ratify it as written. It costs nothing, it is the reason a refusal survives being inconvenient, and FB-23's snapshot requirement gives it a founder-authored cousin. What should not survive is its evidence label.
constraints.ratification_question: Should a committed verdict be unamendable, with changes recorded as additive supersessions? (yes = ratified as founder-authored / no = it is void)

constraints.prior_statement: Write scope is fenced client-side, per lane, by a refusing hook rather than by prose.
constraints.statement: Write scope is fenced client-side, per lane, by a refusing hook rather than by prose. The hook checks that a write was declared and reasoned, not that its target avoided a forbidden list.
constraints.defect_caught: Reproduced twice. The gh CLI holds a GitHub App installation token whose administration permission returns 403, so no agent can read, let alone set, branch protection: server-side enforcement is unavailable from inside an agent. And EC-01 shows a lane can contaminate another lane's branch with an exit code of zero. Client-side refusal is the only enforcement surface that exists here.
constraints.justification: Retained and amended by the founder in the same breath. He keeps the guard and changes what it checks, which is the clearest illustration in the corpus of his authority-versus-mechanism distinction: the mechanism stays, the denylist it consulted goes.
constraints.founder_directed_change: The guard's predicate moves from target-avoidance to declared-and-reasoned. Any implementation still testing a forbidden-path list is enforcing FB-11 under another name.
constraints.implementation_note: The staged guard at l1-cursor-baseline/proposed-cursor-config/dot-cursor/hooks/guard_write_scope.py is another lane's namespace and is not modified here. The required change is reported, not applied.

constraints.statement: Exactly one shared-state writer. Without a deterministic controller, isolated work continues and shared writes fail closed.
constraints.defect_caught: The collision in EC-01 is the instance: two writers on one tree produced a projection whose declared denominator diverged from the actual one. The fail-closed rule is what stops that divergence from being silent.
constraints.justification: Earned, and now also grounded in FA-02's founder-authored concurrency gate. Note what it is not: it is not a limit on how many lanes may run, only on how many may write shared state. The prior register was careful about this and it is worth restating, because a single-writer rule reads like an agent ceiling and the founder removed agent ceilings.

constraints.statement: A subordinate lane may return only READY_TO_COMMIT. Provider completion without a committed artifact stays PROVIDER_OBSERVED indefinitely and is reported that way.
constraints.defect_caught: WS-V010-FULLSCALE-CHATGPT claims DURABLE and is admitted at PROPOSED. Its payload hashes verify exactly, but its result side names a Supabase registry and three Drive receipts that are not in the canonical store, and the transport is a founder-assisted paste separately recorded as FAILED_NOT_BYTE_IDENTICAL.
constraints.justification: Founder-named. Its receipt is shared with FB-05, which is the correct outcome rather than a duplication: one defect - a founder-carried payload that did not survive - evidences both the transport prohibition and the admission rule, because it failed in both directions at once.

constraints.statement: A currentness resolver refuses to answer when competing claims exist. It does not pick the newest, the nearest or the majority.
constraints.defect_caught: Reproduced against the live estate: validate reports COMPETING_CURRENTNESS_CLAIM=4, and resolve --scope pointer.operator-system refuses with three competing blobs across eight branches. Seven branches agreeing against one is still unresolved, because agreement by copying is not authority.
constraints.justification: Retained without change, and it is the control that makes FB-24's purge safe. Removing the founder-bound label from the pointer decision does not licence guessing: the resolver still refuses, and what is now permitted is resolving the conflict with evidence and a snapshot rather than waiting for a founder turn the founder says is unnecessary.

constraints.statement: state/**, operations/**, dispatch/** and modules/work_unit_contract/** are prohibited paths on this branch lineage until pointer reconciliation lands.
constraints.founder_void_quote: No surface is off-limits because of a name on a list.
constraints.what_it_constrains: Four path globs, on every lane in this lineage, indefinitely - 'until pointer reconciliation lands' has no owner and no date.
constraints.removal_unlocks: Pointer reconciliation itself. The paths this forbids are the paths reconciliation must write, so the control forbids the work whose completion is its own expiry condition. With it gone, a lane can reconcile currentness under the three gates: wait for a running reconciliation lane, snapshot the prior pointer state as a tag, and carry the evidence for the claim it writes.
constraints.justification: A named-target prohibition list - the exact shape the founder voided - sitting inside the EARNED class, where a de-restriction lane looking for invented limits would not think to look. Its cited defect does not belong to it: four competing currentness claims are a condition of the estate that this control did not catch and does not fix. What it does is prevent writes to the paths where the condition lives. That is a target-based gate, and the founder replaced target-based gating with reason-based gating in terms that reach it directly.
constraints.replacement_retained: EC-12's refusal and FA-03's evidence gate together do the real work: a write to a pointer path must carry the evidence for the currentness it asserts, and a resolver must still refuse to guess between competing claims. Neither requires a path list.

constraints.statement: Branch existence, file counts, ZIP archives, open pull requests, agent existence, acknowledgements, provider completion and receipt counts cannot advance an admission rung.
constraints.defect_caught: Reproduced live: NON_ADMISSIBLE_EVIDENCE_OFFERED=21 and ADMISSION_OVERCLAIM=8 against the current tree, with eight of sixteen workstreams claiming more than their evidence supports and nothing anywhere reaching DURABLE.
constraints.justification: Earned with a live count. It is also the control that makes the founder's 'Untouched is not a virtue. Correct is' enforceable in the other direction: a run that touched a great deal and produced only inadmissible evidence has also passed nothing.

constraints.statement: Decision classes are partitioned with exactly one holder each, and programme shape is a reserved class no function may claim.
constraints.defect_caught: Reproduced in both directions. Against the estate: UNDIFFERENTIATED_COMMISSION_OVERLAP=7 and COMMISSION_ID_COLLISION=1, including two commissions asserting whole-operation authority over the same paths with no supersession edge. Against the mechanism: negative tests NT1 and NT2 inject exactly those two failures and the validator rejects both.
constraints.justification: Earned. One caveat worth recording: the reservation of programme shape is a partition rule inside the architecture, and its escalation to a founder-held decision class is FB-21, which is on the ratification list. The partition holds regardless of who ends up holding the class.

constraints.statement: A function may not name itself its own acceptance owner, and an assurance container may not host a producing function.
constraints.defect_caught: Negative tests NT3 and NT5 reproduce both rejections. The live instance is AC-12: the producer authored the assertions that graded it, which is self-acceptance wearing a CI badge.
constraints.founder_ratification_quote: independent acceptance that is free to refuse
constraints.justification: Founder-named and mechanised with negative tests. It is also the rule this lane obeys against itself: this register classifies constraints and recommends dispositions, and applies none of them. A lane purging constraints it classified would be a producer accepting its own verdict.

constraints.statement: Every admitted function carries a pre-registered falsifier and an exit condition.
constraints.defect_caught: Negative test NT6 reproduces the rejection of a warrant with no falsifier. The estate-side defect it addresses is recorded by L4 as 'lessons documented without changing the actual mechanism', probed by NonAdmissibleEvidenceTests.test_documented_lesson_that_changes_no_gate_cannot_advance_state.
constraints.justification: Earned, and it is the rule that condemned AI-15: a salvage function whose exit condition is unreachable is a permanent function disguised as a temporary one. A control that rejects a constraint elsewhere in the same register is doing work.

constraints.statement: Lineage, acceptance and coordination state must not live in the Cursor per-run agent store at /cursor/stores/self.
constraints.defect_caught: Reproduced: the store is a FUSE mount keyed to the run's bcId, only self is mounted, foreign store paths fail to be created with No such file or directory rather than a permission error, and nothing in it is visible to the founder, to CI or to any independent acceptor. The probe cleanup additionally destroyed two pre-existing platform CI deliveries, demonstrating the durability class directly.
constraints.justification: Earned, and it carries the surplus removed from FB-07 and FB-22: 'no provider holds canonical state' is not founder-quotable, and it does not need to be, because a store that destroyed two deliveries during a cleanup probe has argued the point on its own.

constraints.statement: Do not add chromeExecutablePath, image, egressMode, egressAllowlist, containerRuntime or build.dockerfileContents to .cursor/environment.json.
constraints.defect_caught: Reproduced: the live schema rejects all six under unevaluatedProperties:false, despite Cursor's own bundled skill listing them as common fields. Following the vendor's own documentation here produces an invalid file.
constraints.justification: Earned. It is also the sharpest instance of FA-09 in the estate: a provider's own documentation is a provider convention, and it was wrong. A constraint derived from vendor docs and a constraint derived from testing vendor docs look identical in a register and are not the same object.

constraints.statement: The cursor-cloud run event log is not an audit trail.
constraints.defect_caught: Reproduced: over a run spanning 13:31Z to 20:15Z the event log contained two entries, both pr_created. It records provider-side milestones and nothing about what the agent did, so an operation that treated it as coverage would be claiming an audit it does not have.
constraints.justification: Earned, with a measured denominator. Two entries over nearly seven hours is the kind of number that settles an argument.

constraints.statement: Event subscriptions are a wake-up mechanism, not a durable channel. Addressable retrieval by immutable SHA stays the primary path.
constraints.defect_caught: Reproduced: list_subscriptions returned zero active subscriptions, so the CI subscription relied on during CUR-01 had already expired or closed, and its deliveries survived only in a per-run store that no later run can address.
constraints.justification: Earned, and the second carrier of the canonical-store surplus removed from FB-07 and FB-22.

constraints.statement: HTTP status is the discriminator for what a GitHub token can do. The X-Accepted-Github-Permissions header and the permissions object on GET /repos are not.
constraints.defect_caught: Reproduced: every GET reports '=read' in the header regardless of the token, and GET /repos returns permissions all-false for an installation token that a successful push dry-run proves can write. Both traps produce confident wrong conclusions in opposite directions.
constraints.justification: Earned. A control that catches an error in both directions is rarer than one that catches it in one, and this is the estate's only example.

constraints.statement: An unconfirmed transcription must be read back before it enters a durable instruction.
constraints.defect_caught: The Aircrift/Aircraft seed. It resolved to no real product across GitHub repositories, users and organisations, the Chrome Web Store, npm, PyPI and DNS, and is recorded UNRESOLVED rather than guessed at. An unconfirmed transcription entered a work order and survived several hands unchallenged.
constraints.justification: Earned, and it is the single stage of FB-14's seven-stage voice pipeline that has a receipt. If FB-14 is not ratified, this is what remains of it, and it is the part that was doing the work.

constraints.statement: A locator is a URL or an exact ID. A display alias is not a locator.
constraints.defect_caught: Reproduced live: ALIAS_USED_AS_LOCATOR=2 against the current tree. The CGPT-01 runtime binding still carries provider_locator 'current_project_conversation' and launch_receipt 'current-founder-appointment', neither of which is a path or a stable ID, so the binding is admitted at PROPOSED.
constraints.justification: Earned, unchanged, and now correctly paired with FB-10, which is the same rule that the prior register certified founder-bound because it was reading a different file.

constraints.statement: Coordination primitives such as lease and canary refs are never counted as delivered scale.
constraints.defect_caught: Reproduced live: COORDINATION_TOKENS_COUNTED_AS_SCALE=1, with 65 orphaned po03 lease and canary refs that have no trunk ancestry and hold a single file each. They are real recovery evidence and they are not work.
constraints.justification: Earned. It is also the counterweight to the founder's scale expectation: he says do not treat raw counts as success either, and 65 refs holding one file each is exactly the count that would otherwise be reported as scale.

constraints.statement: Route paths and model identifiers are discovered at runtime from published indexes, never recalled or guessed, and an exact model is never inferred from an alias.
constraints.defect_caught: Reproduced inside L5's own work: a first pass that guessed plausible documentation paths produced 24 404s out of 34, including a conversations retrieval route that does not exist. Guessing would have put a wrong route into an activation programme handed to the founder.
constraints.justification: Earned, with the strongest defect ratio in the register: 24 wrong out of 34 attempts. A lane that had not measured its own guessing would have shipped those routes.

constraints.statement: As a claim standard, two routes are independent only when they do not share a controller, a failure domain and a custody dependency. Transport diversity is not independence.
constraints.defect_caught: AC-06 and AC-07 FAIL. R2 queried the producing run itself while it was still RUNNING, returned zero events, committed neither raw provider artifact, and depends on R1 and GitHub for durable custody. A single compromised producer could manufacture both records. The PASS_TWO_OR_MORE_ROUTES claim was withdrawn as a result.
constraints.justification: Earned as a claim standard, and correctly distinguished by the prior register from AI-09, which is the same requirement used as a gate on unrelated work and is purged. That distinction is one of the prior register's best pieces of work and is retained unchanged.

constraints.statement: Nothing beyond founder tranche 01 may be prescribed until tranche 01 is evaluated.
constraints.what_it_constrains: All tranche-02-class work, gated on an unrelated evaluation.
constraints.removal_unlocks: The platform role architecture, the acceptance constitution, the salvage design and the Cursor configuration application all stop waiting on an unrelated credential answer.
constraints.justification: Unquotable and defect-free, and additionally now contradicted by FC-03's 'A run that touched nothing and produced nothing has passed nothing.' Verdict unchanged from the prior register, which reached the right answer here by a method that happened to work on this class.

constraints.statement: The founder must issue a new Cursor API key at cursor.com/dashboard/api and store it as a repository-scoped secret.
constraints.what_it_constrains: It is a founder action rather than a limit, and it constrains the estate by consuming a founder turn on a credential that already exists.
constraints.removal_unlocks: The founder action shrinks from creating and scoping a new credential to authorising one already-configured integration, and the Cursor Agent API route becomes reachable through a credential Obzio already controls.
constraints.justification: Unquotable and defect-free. It is now doubly condemned: it is the named defect that earns FB-19, and it is an instance of the class FB-27 forbids, since it rested on an unverified account fact. Verdict unchanged.

constraints.statement: A per-wave founder touch-point budget sizes tranches, and F-LOAD may reject an over-budget design.
constraints.what_it_constrains: The number of founder decisions a design may require.
constraints.removal_unlocks: High-leverage founder decisions stop being rationed against a budget, and a design is no longer rejected for asking too much of the founder when what it asks is genuinely his.
constraints.justification: Unquotable and defect-free, and now positively contradicted: FB-06 is founder-authored and states that a request to him is an authorised reply. The replacement F-LOAD detector remains sound - it refuses a design whose return route makes him relay, which is FB-05's evidenced prohibition mechanised. Verdict unchanged.

constraints.statement: The staged Cursor configuration is held outside .cursor/ and remains inert pending an explicit founder act.
constraints.what_it_constrains: Application of hooks, rules, skills and the write-scope guard.
constraints.removal_unlocks: The enforcement surface itself. L1 reproduced that hooks are the only enforcement surface in this runtime and that the repository has none, so every governance rule in the estate is currently prose enforced by nothing - including every constraint in this register.
constraints.justification: Unquotable and defect-free. Verdict unchanged, and its urgency has increased: the founder has now directed a change to the write-scope guard's predicate, and a guard that is inert cannot be changed in any way that matters.

constraints.statement: MCP integrations are left unauthenticated and treated as out of scope; state the policy now and connect nothing.
constraints.what_it_constrains: Five reachable MCP namespaces that report needsAuth.
constraints.removal_unlocks: Supabase, Vercel and three Cloudflare namespaces become candidate authorised access. Supabase is on the critical path, because it is the route to the Cursor API key that already exists.
constraints.justification: Unquotable and defect-free. Verdict unchanged. The one genuine risk L1 identified is retained as a design constraint rather than a gate: a Slack or Linear connector would create a second place where currentness can be asserted, and that connector class waits for pointer reconciliation.

constraints.statement: ChatGPT/SO-02 is a supporting function, stated without scope.
constraints.founder_contradiction_quote: Use this capability broadly while preserving provenance
constraints.what_it_constrains: ChatGPT's whole operating width, by generalising a scoped correction into an unqualified status claim.
constraints.removal_unlocks: ChatGPT operates at platform scale across projects, models, Work agents, connectors, skills and scheduled cadence, with functions that own decision classes rather than only supplying evidence.
constraints.justification: Verdict unchanged, and the basis is now stronger than the prior register could make it: FC-02 is founder text and says use the account broadly. The prior register argued from a scoping inference; the corpus supplies a direct contradiction.

constraints.statement: ChatGPT's operating function is evidence review, verification and a founder interface.
constraints.founder_contradiction_quote: The entire authorised ChatGPT account-not only active threads-may be used to recover relevant context, initiate follow-ups and message its LLMs for Obzio's intended purposes.
constraints.what_it_constrains: ChatGPT's function set, capping it at review and interface work.
constraints.removal_unlocks: ChatGPT takes the estate's discovery and integration function, which is the only function in the architecture that matches its actual asymmetry: it is the only surface holding the founder's authenticated context and connected tools, and no Cursor agent can reach any of it.
constraints.justification: Verdict unchanged, now with a founder sentence against it rather than an inference. Recorded positively as FA-07.

constraints.statement: One top-level agent, no subagents.
constraints.what_it_constrains: Execution topology.
constraints.removal_unlocks: Already exercised - five isolated lanes ran as subagents under one root controller and this is a later one. What the removal adds is the re-inheritance probe, because the rule was superseded in three separate documents and can be re-read out of any of them.
constraints.justification: Unquotable and defect-free. Verdict unchanged. The controls that make multi-agent operation safe are separately classified and all retained: EC-01, EC-09, EC-10, EC-11.

constraints.statement: Two independent routes must be qualified before useful work proceeds.
constraints.what_it_constrains: All strategic development work, gated on route qualification.
constraints.removal_unlocks: Work proceeds on the one route that survived independent challenge, which is R1 GitHub immutable-SHA custody and is usable now.
constraints.justification: Unquotable and defect-free as a gate. Verdict unchanged. EC-27 retains the identical requirement as a claim standard, which is the distinction that matters: qualifying a route and gating work on route qualification are different acts.

constraints.statement: Until one non-founder return route is qualified end to end, no wave-one function may produce anything.
constraints.founder_contradiction_quote: A run that touched nothing and produced nothing has passed nothing.
constraints.what_it_constrains: All wave-one production.
constraints.removal_unlocks: Wave one produces from the first day, with route qualification running beside it. The risk it guarded is handled by labelling: a function whose only return route is the founder is marked R0-DEGRADED and reported as such rather than prevented from starting.
constraints.justification: Verdict unchanged, and now directly contradicted by founder text. A stop-the-world gate is the purest form of the thing his amendment refuses to accept as a deliverable.

constraints.statement: The five mutating cursor-cloud tools, including trigger-environment-build, are excluded from use.
constraints.what_it_constrains: Five tools, on the basis of a lane brief rather than a boundary.
constraints.removal_unlocks: The single most consequential unverified finding in L1 becomes testable in one call: whether the repository's environment.json can take effect, which decides whether this estate keeps paying a cold start on every agent run.
