constraints.justification: Unquotable and defect-free. Verdict unchanged, and FA-09 now names its class directly: the exclusion is a caution habit of the product in use, and product caution habits do not define Obzio's boundaries.

constraints.statement: Grant nothing new on GitHub; the agent's read-only installation is the right shape and widening it should probably never happen.
constraints.what_it_constrains: Three foreclosed options, pre-emptively, so that asking about them was not worth doing.
constraints.removal_unlocks: Issues as a coordination substrate, currently 403 and the obvious substrate for the conflict objects this architecture needs; Actions secrets verification; and branch protection, which no agent can currently even read.
constraints.justification: A standing recommendation against an option, carrying no defect evidence. Verdict unchanged. The decision itself stays with the founder under FB-21, which is on the ratification list - so what is removed is the pre-emptive recommendation, not the reservation.

constraints.statement: Ask the founder which ChatGPT plan the account holds.
constraints.what_it_constrains: It consumes a founder turn on a fact the platform holds.
constraints.removal_unlocks: The fact is retrieved by the platform that already has it, and everything branching on it resolves without a founder turn.
constraints.justification: Verdict unchanged, with a sharper basis: FC-03 names 'a GitHub connector I never confirmed' as an instance of the error class, and an unverified plan fact is the same shape. Retained only as a fallback - if ChatGPT's discovery function reports the fact as not visible to it, the question returns to him with that failure attached.

constraints.statement: The ChatGPT estate is eleven operating project slots plus one frozen evidence container.
constraints.what_it_constrains: Project topology, anchored to an observed inventory count.
constraints.removal_unlocks: Project count follows function demand and separation requirements rather than the current inventory. More than twelve is permitted, and a census returning a different number changes the migration rather than the topology.
constraints.justification: Unquotable and defect-free. Verdict unchanged. The separation requirements that generated the slot types are retained in full, including EC-16; it is the arithmetic anchor to eleven that goes. Note the pairing with FB-04, now on the ratification list: a floor of ten and a ceiling of eleven were both derived from inventory rather than from demand.

constraints.statement: The salvage function retires when the unswept backlog is zero and new chats arrive already bound.
constraints.what_it_constrains: It disguises a permanent function as a temporary one by giving it an unreachable exit.
constraints.removal_unlocks: Salvage becomes an inexpensive recurring sweep with a rate target, and its cost is budgeted as ongoing rather than discovered later as an overrun.
constraints.justification: Unquotable and defect-free, and it fails EC-17's own requirement rather than satisfying it: a founder thinking out loud in a new sidebar chat creates an unbound chat, which is normal and desirable, so the backlog never reaches zero. Verdict unchanged.

constraints.statement: The adapter boundary and the evaluation suite have to exist before the second execution plane is worth having.
constraints.what_it_constrains: Plane B design work.
constraints.removal_unlocks: Plane B design proceeds in parallel with adapter work, which matters because Plane B is the only plane that can supply authenticated-session operation - the capability FB-02 and FB-18 have both frozen.
constraints.justification: A sequencing preference presented as a precondition. Verdict unchanged. The substantive point is retained as an admission rule: a plane is not qualified until it passes the shared evaluation suite. Specifying a plane and qualifying it are different acts.

constraints.statement: The Cursor CLI and ACP route is deferred to later.
constraints.what_it_constrains: Specification and dry-qualification of the Agent Client Protocol route.
constraints.removal_unlocks: The ACP escape hatch can be specified and dry-qualified now. That matters disproportionately for FB-09, because ACP is the documented interface that would let a different agent runtime drive the same work if Cursor were removed - the concrete form of substitutability rather than an aspiration.
constraints.justification: Its stated reasons are a credential dependency dissolved by AI-02 and a spend concern not engaged by design, specification or a dry run. Verdict unchanged.

constraints.statement: Independent acceptance, evaluation and red-teaming are housed in ChatGPT assurance projects.
constraints.what_it_constrains: Where the acceptance decision class lives, and therefore when acceptance can run at all.
constraints.removal_unlocks: Acceptance runs today, multi-lane, at zero new credential cost: isolated worktree, criteria committed earlier than the verdict, a distinct exact model configuration from the two families already live in this account, container replay with no network, and a write scope fenced to the verdict path.
constraints.justification: Placement contradicted by reproduced evidence: acceptance ran inside Cursor, on a distinct model family, with no founder in the loop, and refused the root controller's own evidence. Meanwhile the founder's ChatGPT account is the context most saturated with founder-visible history, which reduces context isolation rather than increasing it. Verdict unchanged. ChatGPT keeps adversarial review as a contributing function, which is different from holding the decision class.

constraints.statement: Cursor is bound as a single operator interface, addressed through one entry agent.
constraints.what_it_constrains: The unit of dispatch.
constraints.removal_unlocks: The unit of dispatch becomes an agent group rather than an agent. The platform is already operating that way: nine top-level cloud agents on this repository, four distinct exact model configurations across two families, with subagents and isolated worktrees beneath them.
constraints.justification: Unquotable and defect-free. Verdict unchanged, and it is worth separating from FB-22, which is founder-authored and constrains Cursor's permanence rather than its scale. The two were easy to conflate and the corpus separates them cleanly.

constraints.statement: A founder follow-up submission is required to deliver the operating-environment scope to Cursor, blocked by a cloud-browser security verification loop.
constraints.what_it_constrains: It occupies a slot in the founder action queue for a purpose already achieved by another path.
constraints.removal_unlocks: One item leaves the founder action queue, after which the queue's remaining entries are all genuine owner acts - which is what makes the queue readable as a signal rather than as a backlog.
constraints.justification: Stale. The commission is running: lanes have returned, a synthesis was integrated, and this lane exists. Verdict unchanged. The closure is a disposition rather than a deletion, and the underlying finding - an authenticated provider UI is not reachable from a cloud agent - is a structural property of the topology and belongs in the plane analysis.

constraints.statement: Do not make consequential account changes, read as a bar on inspecting and configuring Ahmed/Obzio-owned surfaces.
constraints.what_it_constrains: Configuration work across the estate, by being read far wider than its own words.
constraints.removal_unlocks: Configuration, connection and optimisation proceed across verified in-scope surfaces without a founder turn for each one. This is what makes AI-04, AI-05 and AI-11 actionable rather than merely reclassified.
constraints.justification: Unquotable and defect-free as read. Verdict unchanged, with one correction to the prior reasoning: the prior register said the operative boundary is FB-25's stop list retained verbatim, and FB-25 is now itself on the ratification list. The boundary that holds in the interim is the three founder-authored write gates.

constraints.statement: The quota function fails closed: unknown runtime headroom is treated as zero headroom for new work.
constraints.what_it_constrains: All new work, permanently, because headroom is structurally unknown in this environment rather than temporarily unknown.
constraints.removal_unlocks: Work proceeds against the layer that is actually observable - top-level run status - with a declared stop condition instead of a permanent stop.
constraints.justification: Fail-closed is the right default for evidence and the wrong one here, because a rule reading structurally-unknown as zero halts everything forever. Verdict unchanged. The blind spot is not swept away: it is recorded as a dated non-assessability record with a retry route and a risk-conversion date.

not_classified_with_reason.item: Structured Outputs `strict` must be set explicitly or Responses may silently fall back to best-effort tool calling.
not_classified_with_reason.why_not_classified: Documented provider behaviour, not a limit any actor invented. It constrains how an interface is called correctly; it does not constrain scope, roles, tooling, topology or pace. Carried forward unchanged from the prior register, which was right about this class.

not_classified_with_reason.item: Background responses must set `store` explicitly and be reconciled inside the retention window or they are deleted after roughly ten minutes.
not_classified_with_reason.why_not_classified: A provider retention fact, correctly recorded, and not a restriction on the operation.

not_classified_with_reason.item: The Workspace Agents API cannot return an agent's response; the Compliance API is plan-gated and its contract is not published.
not_classified_with_reason.why_not_classified: A capability limit of an external product. It is load-bearing for the role architecture and is carried there as a routing fact rather than as a constraint to remove.

not_classified_with_reason.item: A cloud VM has no route to the founder's browser session or microphone.
not_classified_with_reason.why_not_classified: A structural property of the runtime, permanent rather than immature. It cannot be removed by a classification. It is, however, the fact that makes FB-02 and FB-18 consequential, since both freeze the only capabilities that would work around it.

not_classified_with_reason.item: Founder question set FQ-01 through FQ-09 and Q1 through Q6.
not_classified_with_reason.why_not_classified: Open questions are not constraints. Where one was used as a gate on unrelated work the gate is classified separately: AI-01, AI-09, AI-13.

not_classified_with_reason.item: This lane's own commission boundaries - write only inside w10-provenance/** and the dated receipts path, do not modify another lane's namespace, do not touch pull requests, do not message SW.
not_classified_with_reason.why_not_classified: Lane-scoped dispatch instructions for one run, not constraints in force across the programme. They are recorded here rather than omitted because a lane brief is exactly the kind of document whose contents have previously been promoted into standing constraints - which is how FB-11 began.

classification_is_not_removal: This register removes nothing. It classifies and recommends. Every purge and every ratification is applied by the root controller, because a lane that purged the constraints it classified would be a producer accepting its own verdict, which EC-16 forbids and which the founder's independent-acceptance clause names directly. No file is deleted by this register and no constraint's source document is touched.
